verdicts.reason: A keeps the design legible with a strong headline, a clear Try It CTA and an intact can, but the product circle is cropped off the top-left canvas edge, the subtitle is indented off the headline's left edge, the right-aligned NEW/Try It stack sits on a different axis from the text, and the bottom third is dead space. B has fallen apart. The cream circle is stranded and clipped in the bottom-left corner, the can body has gone transparent so only an outline with floating dots and a label is left, and the headline, subtitle, NEW badge and CTA are all tiny and scattered across a mostly empty orange field.
